standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic monthly schedule task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: Working from a blank monthly calendar, the learner invents an adult character who lives independently, gives that character a name, an age of at least eighteen, and one or two sentences of invented circumstances (for example, the kind of home they live in and whether they work full time or part time), then rough-blocks each week of the month into the four broad categories before any later lesson refines the details.
materials: learner-local: paper or a blank one-month calendar grid
learner-local: the persona-invention sheet provided on this task sheet

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l01-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l01-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l01-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l01-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Which of the four blocks (work, sleep, errands, rest) was hardest to place realistically on the calendar for your persona, and why?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l01-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l01-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g8-u06-l01-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Persona originality and completeness: Persona has an invented name, a stated age of eighteen or older, and at least one sentence of invented circumstance. | Monthly skeleton coverage and variation: All weeks include all four block categories, and at least one week is noticeably varied from the others. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l01-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner add a fifth block category (such as social time or personal projects) to one week of their persona's month and explain how adding it would force them to trim time from one of the original four blocks.

resources.title: monthly schedule worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: Working from a blank monthly calendar, the learner invents an adult character who lives independently, gives that character a name, an age of at least eighteen, and one or two sentences of invented circumstances (for example, the kind of home they live in and whether they work full time or part time), then rough-blocks each week of the month into the four broad categories before any later lesson refines the details.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact monthly schedule decision or action.
Model move 2: Invent the basic identity of your fictional persona before touching the calendar.
Model move 3: Using your persona's basic identity, block out one representative week before spreading it across the month.

Model check: Persona originality and completeness: Persona has an invented name, a stated age of eighteen or older, and at least one sentence of invented circumstance. | Monthly skeleton coverage and variation: All weeks include all four block categories, and at least one week is noticeably varied from the others.

resources.title: monthly schedule action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for monthly schedule.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: monthly schedule coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Working from a blank monthly calendar, the learner invents an adult character who lives independently, gives that character a name, an age of at least eighteen, and one or two sentences of invented circumstances (for example, the kind of home they live in and whether they work full time or part time), then rough-blocks each week of the month into the four broad categories before any later lesson refines the details.
Coach direction: Invent the basic identity of your fictional persona before touching the calendar.
Learner prompt: Invent a first and last name for your fictional independent-living persona and give them an age of eighteen or older. Write the name and age here.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: monthly schedule complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Using your persona's basic identity, block out one representative week before spreading it across the month.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I marked a work block on my persona's calendar for a realistic number of hours for their job.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I marked a sleep block covering a consistent number of hours each night.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I marked at least one errands block and one rest block somewhere in the week.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: monthly schedule minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Which of the four blocks (work, sleep, errands, rest) was hardest to place realistically on the calendar for your persona, and why?

Success checks: Persona originality and completeness: Persona has an invented name, a stated age of eighteen or older, and at least one sentence of invented circumstance. | Monthly skeleton coverage and variation: All weeks include all four block categories, and at least one week is noticeably varied from the others.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: monthly schedule supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l01-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g8-u06-l01-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional monthly schedule condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Persona originality and completeness: Persona has an invented name, a stated age of eighteen or older, and at least one sentence of invented circumstance. | Monthly skeleton coverage and variation: All weeks include all four block categories, and at least one week is noticeably varied from the others..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l01-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

resources.title: monthly schedule delivered example
resources.purpose: Resolves the lesson's named example so the learner is never directed to a phantom material.

Use steps: Using your persona's basic identity, block out one representative week before spreading it across the month.
Field 1 (t2-p1): I marked a work block on my persona's calendar for a realistic number of hours for their job.
Field 2 (t2-p2): I marked a sleep block covering a consistent number of hours each night.
Field 3 (t2-p3): I marked at least one errands block and one rest block somewhere in the week.

Check against: Persona originality and completeness: Persona has an invented name, a stated age of eighteen or older, and at least one sentence of invented circumstance. | Monthly skeleton coverage and variation: All weeks include all four block categories, and at least one week is noticeably varied from the others.

simulationRoute.title: monthly schedule — complete fictional route

simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g8-u06-l01-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
